notes.title: Genetic Manipulation! (Dev Update 12/2021)
notes.notes:
Hoy!! it's been a lil over a year since the Steam Demo so a development update is long overdue! U・x・U

[h1]What have we been up to?[/h1]

[i]A bunch of things![/i]

[h2]Community Feedback[/h2]

Right after releasing the demo, we worked on integrating some community suggestions to the full game, such as [b]bunny selection and renaming[/b]! It was already a planned feature but hey, figured we should implement it early~
When a bunny is clicked, it becomes the current selection and only its stats will be displayed in the cage!
Once a bunny is selected, click on its name tag to change its name! It doesn't get any easier U(ㅇㅅㅇ❀)U

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/aebe1f378ba3bfefa2e03174fea01afe1a6d5980.gif[/img]

You may also have noticed a [i]new lil icon[/i] at the bottom right of the cage...

Well, after these small changes, we moved on to one of the big pieces of Horribunnies:

[h2]GENETIC MANIPULATION[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/7aa8ab9164b35b42332775944407571feb3bff9c.png[/img]

[b]Here it is in all of its unpolished glory![/b]
This is the heart of the game, the one place where you will craft beauties and monstrosities alike~
Let's go over this bit by bit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/71c67a92ade09c07b992c1c62847b1bf83f7d8de.gif[/img]

This part represents the genome of a given bunny, each pair represents a gene that will define one of the bunny's traits or behaviours! For example, there is a gene that defines the diet of the bunny, if for that gene, the bunny has both herbivore alleles, the bunny will be a herbivore!
Each allele of a pair is clickable for more info... [b]and is up for manipulation[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/113eb0c4170952a1a7ef6fa3e3850c00429cd172.gif[/img]

To mutate an allele into what you desire, you pick a viable alternative among the ones you have discovered! Once you're ready, press Mutate!

This UI still needs a lot of work to look and feel even better (like have a lil animation when the mutation happens <3) but we hope you liked this early glimpse~

[h2]Other mechanics[/h2]

Progress has also been made in other areas:
[list]
[*]Dynamic narration: As you may already know, the game will branch into different routes depending on your actions and how they reflect with your relationship with both Pâquerette and Ophéline. Well, time has now been spent designing the underlying system, with its implementation underway!
[*]Idle mechanics: SImilarly to other pet games, bunnies keep growing even when the game is off. This implies quite the work on saving/loading + simulating time spent! We're also making sure the game is as fun as for players who play small sessions (~5-10 minutes) and players who spend hours in one sitting so we've been working on mechanics to keep the game interesting for longer sessions, more on that in a later update!
[/list]

[h1]Why is it taking so long??[/h1]
If you've been following us for a while, you know that Horribunnies started being developed back in Fall 2019, meaning it's already been 2 years in the making! What's up with that?
[i]A bunch of things as well![/i]
[list]
[*]This is our first commercial release and gamedev is hard! We're a small team that, while a lil experienced with game development, started working on this one-of-a-kind ambitious project at our own pace! Please bear with us while we make this as good as possible U(⁎˃ᆺ˂)U Note that most of the team currently isn't able to work full-time on Horribunnies!
[*]We started working on a spin-off, Pâquerette Down the Bunburrows, back in April 2021, emboldened by how well received it was during Ludum Dare, we can now safely say this project is around 60% complete and we've been coming back to Horribunnies over the last months!
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
[list]
[*]We'll try to make these development updates more frequent! We still have a lot to share with you all :3
[*]While we don't have a release date yet, Pâquerette Down the Bunburrows has also made some serious progress so expect some news in the coming months!
[*]Horribunnies continues its development! Its speed will depend on various factors, including the fundings we hope to secure, so no dates yet!
[/list]

There you go buns! Hope you enjoyed this update! Please share your thoughts below: it's your feedback that will truly help make the game better!

If any, we already have one question for you: What genes/traits would you like to see in Horribunnies ?

notes.title: Spin-off game announcement!!
notes.notes:
Heya bunnies! (๑╹ᆺ╹)

As the title implied, [b]we have an announcement[/b]!
We're currently working on [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628610/Paquerette_Down_the_Bunburrows/]Pâquerette Down the Bunburrows[/url][/b][/i], a short puzzle-game featuring Pâquerette, coming out soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/67aa34d7d575d64e3ca58490cb431f0bcacf545a.gif[/img]

[h1]Pâquerette Down the Bunburrows???[/h1]
We participated in the latest Ludum Dare where we submitted Pâquerette Down the Bunburrow (without the -s!), a lil puzzle-game produced in 3 days by the 3 bunnies from Horribunnies' core team! The game reached the top 1% of the jam and given how positive the feedback was, we figured [b]we should flesh it out into a full release[/b]!

[b]We want to keep the game short, neat and tidy[/b], so you can expect the same experience as the gamejam's version but with more levels, more mechanics and some secrets~

[h1]What about Horribunnies???[/h1]
Fret not! [u]Horribunnies is still very much in development[/u], but given the sheer scope of the game, we believe releasing another shorter game sooner would be a nice way to help you wait for the main course and continue building the community in the meantime! :)

[h1]Ok, what should I do??[/h1]
You should go [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628610/Paquerette_Down_the_Bunburrows/]wishlist the game on Steam here[/url] and stay tuned for the release!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/449948daaba64f6bcbc5d7c29173721af03159c7.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/449948daaba64f6bcbc5d7c29173721af03159c7.gif[/img][/url]

That's it!
Cya! <3

notes.title: Demo hotfix 19/06/20
notes.notes:
We updated the demo again! :3
Here's what we changed:

[list]
[*]The clouds are now moving in the main menu <3
[*]There is now a little watch indicating how much time is left until the arrival of Ophéline and then until the end of the demo so you can manage your time better!
[*]The demo's timer is now stopped when doing Ophéline's "special order", no need to rush her dialogue anymore if you don't want to lose time :p
[*]We improved the font used when displaying numbers (item quantities, prices...) in non-latin languages to make them look better!
[/list]

The Festival is going so well, thank you all for your feedback and support <3

notes.title: Public Demo available!!
notes.notes:
[b]Hoy bunnies! ／(≧ x ≦)＼
The [i]Steam Summer Festival[/i] just started and guess who's in??[/b] :)

[h3]Steam Summer Festival???[/h3]

[i]Steam Summer Festival[/i] will last from [b]June 16th to June 22th[/b]!
[b]It is an official Steam event that allows you to play free short demos of many upcoming games, [i]Horribunnies[/i] included![/b]


[h3]Horribunnies???[/h3]

Horribunnies is a kawaii bunny-raising game... or is it? You care for your little bunnies by feeding them, reproducing them... and selling them away! 💸
However, the adoption applications you receive will sometimes require you to do a lil genetic engineering to produce the right bun 😏

🐇 Bond with the cutest virtual bunnies you've ever seen. They come in all shapes and sizes but require the same amount of petting!
🥕 Get food, equipment, and cosmetics for your buns so they'll be as happy as bunnily possible!!
🌸 Everything is as flashy and sweet as it gets, from lovely graphics to sugary music... You're guaranteed to melt with joy!
📫 Put up some of your bunnies for adoption so you can focus more on your favorites.
🔬 Traits are inherited genetically, so breed responsibly! You don’t want cheap-looking bunnies, do you?
💉 Genetically engineer your bunnies to boost their value: If you figure out how their genes work, you can land a killer bun!
🔀 Take an alternative approach: Ophéline's methods may not be to Pâquerette’s taste, but if you stick with her, you will definitely change this pet shop.

Will your bunny business become the sweetest or the most profitable? 💉🌸

[h3]What can I expect from the demo? :o[/h3]

You'll be able to put your paws on [i]Horribunnies[/i] for the very first time:
[list]
[*]Learn how to take the best care of your bunnies with Pâquerette! Expect to do some feeding, some brushing and more! :3
[*]Turn a quick profit from some baby bunnies with tips from Ophéline
[*]Take pictures of your baby boos!!
[*]Some surprises!!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868484/d579283a2afc9281b2c4797fe241964db7fadee6.gif[/img]


[h3]But who are youuu?[/h3]

We're a small french artistic collective which has been working on the game for the past 8 months! You'll get a chance to know more about everyone during our community events: As part of the festival, we'll be doing an [b]AMA session[/b] and [b]a livestream[/b]! Take a look at our other announcements!

You can also come hang out on [url=https://discord.gg/phGXxPp]our Discord server[/url]!

[h3]That's it!![/h3]

Of course, this demo represents only a tiny bit of what we have in mind for [i]Horribunnies[/i]!
However, we believe the bunnies are already cute enough to melt your hearts <3

Hope you'll like our demo!! Love and bunnies <3 If you like it, help some buns out: [i]don't forget to add the game to your wishlist[/i]!! (⁎˃ᆺ˂)

notes.title: New Character Reveal: Ophéline!
notes.notes:
This week, we unveiled [b]Ophéline[/b]! 💉 

She's the one in charge of the back room of the petshop and she loves bunnies just as much as Pâquerette... in her own way. 💸
Let's say she knows how to make bunnies turn into Horribunnies. 😏
Breeding, genetic engineering and capitalizing on the "long-eared goods" are some of her fields of expertise.
As her methods worry Pâquerette, you may end up having to pick sides. ⚡️

Take a look at her reveal trailer below!

[previewyoutube=EJijVs39aao;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and J-2 before Steam Game Festival! 🎉
We can't wait to get your feedback on the demo!
